_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. Nothing settles tonight because nothing was sold. 124.36 of the balance sits in 4 UPST from the 13:34:59 ET directed fill, marked at 122.92 against the 30.73 bid, and 4.54 is settled cash. Total 127.50 against 127.70 an hour ago, the 0.20 being the position marked to market rather than any movement of funds. Deployable stays 4.54, below the price of a single share of every name on the candidate list - the cheapest is SOUN at 6.40 - so the account is fully committed and will stay that way until something is sold.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Dead on both reasons, and the clock has now closed it rather than the tape. AMD is bid 487.22 at 15:22 ET against a 518.58 official close, about -6.0%, seven cents better than an hour ago. The sequence is 491.73, 486.55, 482.06, 488.79, 485.92, 487.15, 487.22 - seven reads inside a five-dollar band below the gap, which is chop, not repair. The mechanical reason is unchanged: deployable cash is 4.54. And this is the last mid-session read, so 'still holding 30-60 min after the open' has no remaining hour to be tested in today. The setup does not carry forward - a day-2 continuation read on the 8/6 open is a new setup with a new trigger, not this one resumed.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Conditional on a strong leader, and the leader is -6.0%. UPST at +1.4% is the only green on the list now - OKLO gave back its +0.1% and is bid 43.32, dead flat at -0.0% - and one name up 1.4% while it bleeds intraday is not a chain to hunt a laggard in. SMCI, the name this read pointed at, is bid 30.86, about -2.6%, having fallen 0.38 in the hour and become one of the weaker names on the list rather than a laggard about to catch up. Dead on the same 4.54 deployable that closes the other entry setups, and dead on the clock with this the last mid-session slot.

entryWatch.trigger: A pullback that holds on 8/6 or 8/7, not today's reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Dead as an entry, because the account is already long the name. A directed fill at 13:34:59 ET bought 4 UPST at a 31.0899 average - the reaction-day entry this setup existed to wait past - so the 8/6-8/7 pullback is no longer something this board can act on. Adding to the position on that pullback would be averaging down, which docs/RULES.md lists under 'does not fit', and there is 4.54 to do it with in any case. UPST is bid 30.73 at 15:22 ET against a 30.32 close, about +1.4%, extending the sequence to 33.81 after-hours, 32.23 open, 32.36, 32.05, 31.63, 31.26, 30.84, 30.73 - eight reads, and every read since the 32.36 high has been lower than the one before it, five in a row. The one thing that changed this hour is the size of the step: the prior four legs were -0.31, -0.42, -0.37 and -0.42, and this one is -0.11. That is a smaller decline, not a turn, and the distinction matters because the pullback this setup wanted was a hold, not a slower bleed. The entry now sits 0.36 above the bid.

entryWatch.trigger: Leader gapped down, most of the list red, only catalyst is a reaction-day spike
entryWatch.why: The branch the open resolved to and held for four hours, ended at 13:34:59 ET by a directed fill rather than by the tape. It is marked dead because the account is no longer flat and a board that still described itself as standing aside while holding 4 UPST would be contradicting its own exit panel. Recording what the branch was worth while it ran: it was correct on its own terms every hour it was checked, and the reaction-day spike it declined to buy has fallen from a 32.23 open bid to 30.73. It did not fail; it was overtaken. With the mid-session slots now finished, the entry question does not reopen until the account has settled cash again, and nothing settles tonight because nothing was sold.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-05 15:22 ET, live session bids. The Last column is the official 8/4 settled close.
candidatesNote: Bids are live and quoted as bids, never marks. Re-read at 15:22 ET by the sixth and last mid-session run. This is not an entry list: deployable settled cash is 4.54, below a single share of every name on it - the cheapest is SOUN at 6.40 - so it is context for the open UPST position rather than a menu. UPST is the one that matters and it leaked an eighth read to a 30.73 bid, 0.36 below the 31.0899 the position was filled at, though the step down this hour was the smallest of the day. Eight of nine names are red and OKLO gave back its +0.1% to sit exactly flat, leaving UPST the only green. The four names reporting tonight stay no-fly, and none of them is held, so the pre-close run inherits no 3:55p flatten obligation.
